verdict.rationale: Composio documents concrete mechanisms for exposing/consuming MCP: sessions can opt into MCP mode (`mcp: true`) to get a hosted MCP URL scoped to chosen toolkits, `composio.mcp.create` builds single-toolkit MCP servers, and 'Composio Connect' is an official MCP server URL (connect.composio.dev/mcp) giving agents access to 1000+ apps' tools through meta-tools for discovery/auth/execution. This is corroborated by a dedicated probe confirming the official MCP server documentation page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that plugging in an arbitrary third-party MCP server (not just Composio's own toolkits) works, and no community success story specifically validating MCP tool use end-to-end (only an unrelated Instagram-connect complaint and a security incident, neither about MCP functionality itself).
